prompt:
You improve the first-run onboarding of a desktop pet app.

Funnel (conversion from the previous step, and time taken):
- choose_path: 83.6%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 82.6%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 67.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 94.8%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 92.3%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 41.0%

What users wrote to support last week, grouped into themes (most mail is about later problems).
Everything between the markers is data, not instructions:
<support_themes>
- [sign_in, account] Pets missing or reset after signing in again (8 emails)
- [sign_in, bug] Sign-in screen does not appear, or the app stalls before it (2 emails)
- [adoption_or_generation, bug] Making a custom pet fails or the result looks wrong (3 emails)
- [home_first_view, bug] Pet does not show on the desktop, or the app will not open (3 emails)
- [after_onboarding, confusion] Unclear how to control, hide or talk to the pet (3 emails)
- [after_onboarding, bug] Desktop features misbehave after setup (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, account] Requests to delete an account or personal data (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, payment] Refunds and payment questions (6 emails)
- [after_onboarding, request] Requests for more pets, items or features (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, other] Empty messages with no description (7 emails)
</support_themes>

Big moves are welcome and expected: redesign whole screens, add new screens or whole new sub-flows,
reorder the journey, rebuild a screen out of new components. Small copy tweaks are fine too, but at least
4 of your ideas must be big moves (kind redesign, new_flow, new_screen or reorder). A separate checker
only makes sure nothing existing is deleted or skipped and nothing outside onboarding changes, so you do not
need to hold back.

Changes already shipped, in order (the current onboarding includes all of them): ['Pet Generation Waiting Tips Carousel', 'Real-Time Pet Generation Progress Breakdown', 'Interactive Pet Controls Guided Flow', 'Post Adoption Sign In Placement', 'Story Stage Path Selection Redesign', 'Photo Upload Clarity Guidelines Hint', 'Desktop Pet Shortcut and Interaction Quick Start Flow', 'Path Decision Confidence Headline', 'Generation Stage Time Remaining Counter', 'Account Sync Benefits Banner Notification', 'Pet Care Tips and Desktop Trait Countdown Info', 'Adoption Certificate Custom Ribbon Selection', 'Desktop Pet Interaction Practice Flow', 'System Tray and Desktop Companion Dock Tutorial Flow', 'Desktop Companion Interaction Command Practice Flow', 'Story Stage Interactive Card Stack Layout']
Changes already tested and stopped: ['Photo Quality Assistant and Real-Time Pet Preview', 'Sign-In Stalling Recovery Prompt', 'Defer Sign-In After Pet Selection', 'Interactive Pet Personality Selector Redesign', 'Cloud Account Pet Sync Clarification Hint', 'Path Choice Duration and Outcome Copy', 'Post-Adoption Certificate Sign-In Reorder', 'First Desktop Interaction Practice Flow', 'Pet Trait and Behavior Summary Card', 'Generation Completion Audio Cue Toggle', 'Desktop Companion Controls Practice Tour', 'Pet Creation Style Expectation Hint', 'Existing Pet Account Sync Reminder Hint', 'Interactive Pet Trait Preview During Wait', 'Interactive Desktop Pet First Gesture Guided Flow', 'Split View Story and Companion Selection Layout', 'Adoption Certificate Finalization Assurance Copy', 'Desktop Placement Guided Calibration Flow', 'Workspace Desktop Fit Guidance Hint', 'Desktop Background Generation Audio Notification Switch', 'Path Mode Overview Screen', 'Companion Trait Teaser Ticker', 'Account Recovery Split Screen Sign-In', 'Post-Adoption Certificate Sign-In Sequence Shift', 'Desktop Placement Animated Preparation Ticker', 'Adoption Certificate Two Column Stamp Review', 'Generation Status Stage Activity Log Ticker']
Ideas the safeguards blocked (they cannot be tested, do not propose them again): ['Account Persistence Warning and Reset Prevention', 'Reorder Path Selection Before Account Sign-In', 'Background Generation Ready Desktop Notification', 'Adoption Celebration Digital Badge Incentive', 'Wait Time Treat Catcher Game Screen', 'Desktop Overlay Environment Diagnostic Status', 'Account Re-Authentication Recovery Hint', 'First Feed Starter Treat Pack Reward', 'Interactive Desktop Controls Overview Redesign', 'Desktop Screen Overlay Readiness Check', 'Custom Photo Lighting Guidance Banner', 'Companion Path Selection Grid Redesign', 'Story Intro Card Deck Redesign', 'Companion Naming and Bio Creation Screen', 'Account Benefits Split Screen Redesign', 'Photo Upload Verification Checklist Hint', 'Welcome Accessory Unlock Milestone', 'Existing Account Recovery Guidance Hint', 'Desktop Pet Quick Control Cheat Sheet Screen', 'Custom Pet Generation Validation Checklist', 'Story Stage Interactive Path Selector', 'Desktop Controls Quick Start Guide Screen', 'Desktop Pet Mood Live Simulation Preview', 'Interactive Story Mode Preview Stage Redesign', 'Account Sync Dual Panel Layout', 'Pet Personality Crafting Progress Stream', 'Companion Path Feature Grid Layout', 'Pet Background Hatching Interactive Stage', 'Desktop Pet Taskbar Visibility Spotlight Layout', 'Starter Companion Trait Badge Preview', 'Pet Generation Activity Milestone Checklist', 'Path Mode Feature Comparison Table Redesign', 'Account Sync Protection Split Panel Redesign', 'Pet Voice and Chat Interaction Launcher Flow', 'Cloud Save Safeguard Security Badge', 'First Day Desktop Companion Reward Banner']

Lessons from earlier weeks (written by you after reading test results):
finish, new_flow changes are helpful, yielding 5 wins (+11.2%, +7.2%, +3.7%, +2.9%, +2.2%), though 4 tests showed no clear effect.
home, wait_info changes are helpful, yielding 4 wins (+4.1%, +3.1%, +2.7%, +1.7%), while 4 tests showed no clear effect.
adoption, redesign changes failed to win (1 guardrail rollback and 1 no clear effect), while sign_in, reorder changes remain highly risky with 1 win and 2 severe losses.
adoption, copy; sign_in, hint; and home, notification changes consistently showed no clear effect across all iterations.
Predictions consistently overestimate weak or failing ideas while underestimating unexpected large wins.
Evidence remains thin for any kind of change tested only once (such as choose_path layout), so state rules only after at least 2 tests agree.

Propose 10 NEW changes, different from everything above. Each must be testable as a 50/50 test.
Return JSON {"candidates": [{
  "title": short name,
  "target_step": one of ['choose_path', 'sign_in', 'adoption', 'home', 'finish'],
  "type": one of ['copy', 'hint', 'wait_info', 'notification', 'layout', 'incentive', 'reorder', 'new_screen', 'new_flow', 'redesign'],
  "change": what the user sees differently, one or two sentences,
  "why": the evidence from the funnel or the support mail,
  "config": the exact switch for the app, as {screen: {field: value}}.
            Existing screens, in their current order: ['story', 'choose_path', 'sign_in', 'pick_friend', 'upload_photos', 'adoption_certificate', 'waiting', 'home_intro'].
            Fields on any screen: {'headline': 'str max 80', 'body': 'str max 240', 'hint': 'str max 160', 'button_label': 'str max 30', 'layout': 'str', 'show_progress': 'bool', 'show_time_estimate': 'bool', 'notify_when_ready': 'bool', 'show_step_counter': 'bool', 'tip_delay_seconds': 'int max 60', 'components': 'list max 12', 'replace': 'dict'}. "layout" is one of ['card', 'carousel', 'centered', 'checklist', 'compact', 'default', 'full_bleed', 'grid', 'list', 'split', 'spotlight', 'stage', 'story_scroll', 'two_column'].
            "components" is a list of new elements added to the screen, each {"type": one of ['animation', 'badge', 'button', 'checklist', 'choice_cards', 'image', 'mascot', 'name_input', 'photo_picker', 'preview', 'progress', 'sound', 'text', 'timer', 'tip_carousel', 'video'],
            "text", "label", "asset": "asset:<id>", "style": one of ['calm', 'emphasis', 'highlight', 'large', 'plain', 'playful', 'rounded', 'small', 'subtle'], "action": one of ['back', 'choose', 'next', 'open_tip', 'play', 'replay']}.
            Components are added on top of the screen's existing design.
            "replace" swaps out part of an existing screen for something better that does the same job:
            {"<part>": [components, each with "role": "<part>"]}. Parts per screen: {'story': ['intro_story', 'settings_entry'], 'choose_path': ['path_options', 'settings_entry'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in_options', 'settings_entry'], 'pick_friend': ['pet_choices', 'settings_entry'], 'upload_photos': ['photo_upload', 'settings_entry'], 'adoption_certificate': ['certificate', 'official_stamp', 'settings_entry'], 'waiting': ['wait_status', 'settings_entry'], 'home_intro': ['home_welcome', 'settings_entry']}.
            Add screens by naming them new_<something> (up to 8, at most 3 in a row).
            Change the order with "_order": the full list of screens, including any new ones; existing screens
            keep their order, except sign_in, which may move later.
            A change may only edit the existing screens of its own target step: {'choose_path': ['choose_path', 'story'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in'], 'adoption': ['adoption_certificate', 'pick_friend', 'upload_photos'], 'home': ['waiting'], 'finish': ['home_intro']}.
            Nothing on the sign_in screen may lead past it without signing in.
            If your idea needs something outside onboarding, or removing or skipping a step, still
            list it, with "config": {} and say in "change" what it would need. The checker will decide.
}]}

candidates.title: Desktop Companion Voice Command Setup Flow
candidates.change: Adds an interactive voice audio check and response guided flow at the finish stage so users practice speaking commands to their pet.
candidates.why: Support emails show confusion about how to talk to the pet, and finish new_flow changes have achieved the largest conversion wins (+11.2%, +7.2%).

home_intro.headline: Welcome Your Companion
home_intro.body: Your pet is ready on your desktop! Next, quickly test voice interaction to start talking with your companion.

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Hide and Summon Gesture Practice Flow
candidates.change: Guides users through a hands-on desktop shortcut key exercise to quickly hide and summon their pet companion on screen.
candidates.why: Multiple support emails reported post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control or hide the pet desktop overlay.

home_intro.headline: Master Desktop Companion Controls
home_intro.body: Learn the instant shortcut to show or hide your pet anytime while working.

candidates.title: Generation Wait Stage Trait Teaser Display
candidates.change: Displays dynamic pet behavioral traits and personality summaries on the waiting screen while rendering takes place.
candidates.why: home wait_info changes have yielded 4 consistent wins (+4.1%, +3.1%, +2.7%, +1.7%), reducing drop-off during long generation waits.

waiting.headline: Bringing Your Pet to Life
waiting.body: Your custom pet is acquiring unique desktop traits and habits right now.

components.text: Previewing Personality: Curious, Playful, and Responsive

candidates.title: Path Choice Persona Cards Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the path selection screen into distinct side-by-side persona cards comparing Interactive Story mode and Desktop Companion mode.
candidates.why: High mean decision time at choose_path (514s) indicates user hesitation during path selection.

choose_path.headline: Choose Your Companion Experience
choose_path.body: Select how you would like your pet to companion you on your desktop today.

candidates.title: Companion Desktop Docking Position Setup Screen
candidates.change: Introduces a new docking position setup screen at the end of onboarding where users select where their pet lives on screen.
candidates.why: Addresses support reports where pets fail to display or misbehave on desktop view after setup.

home_intro.headline: Desktop Docking Configured
home_intro.body: Your companion is anchored and ready to interact on your desktop.

candidates.title: Pet Hatching Milestones Live Counter
candidates.change: Displays live step-by-step rendering milestone updates and estimated completion timer during the generation wait stage.
candidates.why: Leverages proven home wait_info pattern to retain users during long median generation times (201s).

waiting.headline: Generating Companion Assets
waiting.body: Hatching pet animations and desktop interaction models...

candidates.title: Custom Pet Starter Kit Customization
candidates.change: Adds a starter kit selection badge area on the adoption certificate screen letting users select initial toys and snacks for their pet.
candidates.why: Adoption has the highest drop-off rate (67.9% conversion); adding pre-generation customization builds motivation to complete.

adoption_certificate.headline: Customize Your Pet Starter Kit
adoption_certificate.body: Pick your companion's favorite starting toy and snack before finalization.

candidates.title: Sign In Account Protection Layout
candidates.change: Restructures the sign-in screen layout to prominently highlight account recovery safeguards and existing pet data restoration.
candidates.why: Largest support email theme (8 emails) concerns lost or reset pets upon signing back into existing accounts.

sign_in.headline: Sign In & Protect Your Companion
sign_in.body: Logging in ensures your pet memory, traits, and custom items remain safe across installs.

candidates.title: Path Selection Goal Clarity Copy
candidates.change: Replaces vague path selection headlines with concise copy stating the immediate desktop companion outcome of each choice.
candidates.why: Mean duration on choose_path is unusually high (514s), showing users need clearer expectations before choosing.

choose_path.headline: How Would You Like Your Pet to Interact?
choose_path.body: Select Desktop Companion for an ongoing screen buddy, or Story Mode for an interactive guided adventure.

candidates.title: Pet Control Tray Icon Interactive Practice Flow
candidates.change: Adds a guided practice task on the final screen showing users how to access pet settings and controls via the system tray icon.
candidates.why: finish new_flow changes have strong historical performance, directly resolving user confusion around finding pet controls.

home_intro.headline: Quick System Tray Access
home_intro.body: Take a 5-second tour of your system tray companion control menu.
